ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast macro distribution; dark-field pixels account for approximately 96% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels restricted to isolated focal anomalies and serration edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black contiguous mapping across both lobes. Focal high-contrast circular blobs clustered at the far left distal tip. A singular, high-contrast white ring located at the approximate mid-point of the left lobe. Dispersed, low-intensity white linear streaks concentrated on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped vertex; calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile; sharp peaks and jagged valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary edge line, continuous from distal tips to median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the upward-tilted distal tips and curving inward toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of approximately 12 high-contrast circular pixel groups (barnacles) on the outer edge of the left lobe; 3-4 isolated circular white anomalies observed on the inner-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, thin, white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) clearly visible on the dorsal-right lobe and scattered on the inner-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Colonization of sessile barnacles on the far-left terminal edge; distinct circular 'O-shaped' scar on the central-left lobe; extensive superficial rake marks across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly defined, isolated circular white ring scar located on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe, distinct from typical rosette scarring patterns.
